comment: The importance of current-state assessment is correctly emphasised, but the document does not specify a standard assessment method or minimum evidence set. Different countries may therefore produce assessments that are not comparable or sufficiently rigorous.

public.text: The importance of current-state assessment is correctly emphasised, but the document does not specify a standard assessment method or minimum evidence set. Different countries may therefore produce assessments that are not comparable or sufficiently rigorous.
public.suggestedRevision: Provide a reusable assessment template covering systems, capabilities, data, interfaces, governance, standards, security, infrastructure, cost, contracts, use, coverage, performance, and planned retirement.
